definition: Premature aging, in this context, means signs that the immune system may be showing age-related decline earlier than expected. The packet describes it as a possible pattern of reduced immune function in some people with panic disorder, suggested by biological markers consistent with impaired thymus and regulatory T-cell function.

reasons: The definition’s phrase “age-related decline earlier than expected” is not directly supported in the packet text (the packet tests for “premature aging” but does not describe it as “earlier than expected”).

The definition broadens “biological markers consistent with impaired thymus and regulatory T-cell function” into a broader claim of “signs that the immune system may be showing age-related decline,” while the packet specifically reports reduced TRECs and FOXP3 promoter hypermethylation (and discusses these as potentially reflecting impaired thymus and immunosuppressive Treg function).

The definition states the pattern is “in some people with panic disorder,” but the packet’s significant findings are described for “female (but not male) patients,” so the “some people” wording is defensible only if kept at that level of specificity; as written it is less precise than the packet supports.
